name: Autodesk Fusion
description: Browse Fusion hubs, projects, folders, files and versions. Read-only.
help: Create an app at aps.autodesk.com > My Apps (Fusion 360 + Data Management APIs). Paste the Client ID + secret below, press Connect and approve in the browser. Sign-in refreshes itself. Browsing only in this version: uploads are a two-step flow and come next.
